sections.skill: Interpret the terms, factors, and coefficients of an expression in context

questions.skill: Interpret the terms, factors, and coefficients of an expression in context
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: A gym charges C = 35 + 20m dollars for m months of membership. What do 35 and 20 represent?
questions.prompt_markup:
A gym charges C = 35 + 20m dollars for m months of membership.
What do 35 and 20 represent?
questions.correct_answer: 35 is a one-time joining fee in dollars; 20 is the cost in dollars for each month.
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent wording. Both meanings are required.

questions.skill: Interpret the terms, factors, and coefficients of an expression in context
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: The expression 1.08p gives the total cost, including sales tax, of an item with price p. What does the factor 1.08 tell you?
questions.prompt_markup:
The expression 1.08p gives the total cost, including sales tax, of an item with price p.
What does the factor 1.08 tell you?
questions.correct_answer: The total is 108% of the price: the price plus 8% tax (1.08p = p + 0.08p).
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent wording that names the 8% tax.

questions.skill: Interpret the terms, factors, and coefficients of an expression in context
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: The perimeter of a rectangle is 2(l + w). What does the factor (l + w) represent?
questions.prompt_markup:
The perimeter of a rectangle is 2(l + w).
What does the factor (l + w) represent?

choices.text: Half the perimeter: one length plus one width

questions.correct_answer: Half the perimeter: one length plus one width
questions.grading_note: 2(l + w) is two copies of (l + w), so (l + w) is half of the perimeter.

questions.skill: Interpret the terms, factors, and coefficients of an expression in context
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: For the expression 3x² - 5x + 7, name its terms, the coefficient of x, and the constant term.
questions.prompt_markup: For the expression 3x² - 5x + 7, name its terms, the coefficient of x, and the constant term.
questions.correct_answer: Terms: 3x², -5x, and 7; the coefficient of x is -5; the constant term is 7.
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent form. All three parts are required. The sign belongs to the term: the x-term is -5x.

questions.grading_note: Multiplying by 0.9 keeps 90% of the value each year, so the car loses 10% each year.

questions.domain: Algebra: Arithmetic with Polynomials & Rational Expressions
questions.skill: Rewrite a rational expression and interpret its parts
questions.standard_level: Algebra II. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra II, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: A company's average cost per item for n items is (500 + 3n) ÷ n dollars. Rewrite it as a sum of two terms, and say what each term means.
questions.prompt_markup:
A company's average cost per item for n items is (500 + 3n) ÷ n dollars.
Rewrite it as a sum of two terms, and say what each term means.
questions.correct_answer: 3 + 500/n: $3 is the cost of making each item, and 500/n is each item's share of a $500 fixed cost.
questions.grading_note: Form required: 3 + 500/n (in either order). Both meanings are required.

questions.domain: Algebra: Arithmetic with Polynomials & Rational Expressions

questions.prompt_markup: Assume x ≠ 0. Rewrite (2x + 5) ÷ x in the form a + b/x.
questions.grading_note: Form required: a + b/x. (2x + 5)/x = 2x/x + 5/x.

questions.skill: Compose functions and interpret the composite in context
questions.standard_level: Precalculus. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Precalculus, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: T(h) = 20 + 5h is a temperature in °C after h hours, and h(t) = t ÷ 60 converts t minutes to hours. Write T(h(t)) in simplest form, and say what it gives.
questions.prompt_markup:
T(h) = 20 + 5h is a temperature in °C after h hours, and h(t) = t ÷ 60 converts t minutes to hours.
Write T(h(t)) in simplest form, and say what it gives.
questions.correct_answer: T(h(t)) = 20 + t/12: the temperature after t minutes.
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent form, such as 20 + 5t/60. The meaning is required.
